title: XFS: Recent and Future Adventures in Filesystem Scalability - Dave Chinner
summary: Dave Chinner's linux.conf.au 2012 talk on XFS scalability, covering pain points with large numbers of files and complex metadata, and the work to fix XFS metadata performance.
why: HN recommends it as the definitive explanation of XFS metadata performance fixes and how XFS was developed and made robust on Linux.

quote.text: Please check this talk from Dave Chinner, where he explains how XFS was developed and ported to Linux
